result.summary: Found 4 visual issues: duplicate restaurant cards in Fastest near you, bottom content hidden behind tab navigation, truncated restaurant name, and inconsistent favorite icon styling.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with same image, time (15-25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90 delivery) appear side-by-side in 'Fastest near you'
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant list data so each venue appears only once in the carousel

issues.description: Bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the bottom tab bar - image is clipped and restaurant name, rating and delivery info are not visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset so scrolling content sits above the Home/Search/Orders/Profile navigation

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated name 'Smash Bros Bu' clipped mid-word
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles truncate with ellipsis and full name becomes visible on scroll, rather than clipping mid-character

issues.description: Favorite heart icons have inconsistent styling: Ramen card shows white outline with no background, pizza card shows white outline on dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent wishlist button style with semi-transparent dark background for visibility on all images
